system.text:
This character is bathed in a divine light. Any character with the Lawbreaker, Dreaded, Spirit Nature or Aura of Malevolence trait must immediately take a Steel test when entering the holy character’s presence. Add the holy character’s Will exponent to the hesitation obstacle. In addition, this character’s Suasion dice are always considered open-ended.

Type: Dt (die trait). Cost: 7 pts.

Restrictions: Humans and Roden only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 313
